feed.title: Huntbase Hub
feed.subtitle: Threat hunts drafted from current public research, reviewed by a person, published as open hunt.md files.

entry.title: Mobile Ingress and Device Code Hijacking
entry.summary: An adversary is targeting employees with mobile phishing links (smishing) that lure them into performing Entra ID device-code authentication, allowing the attacker to hijack cloud sessions from compromised or unmanaged mobile devices.

entry.title: ARTEX-Driven Cloud Persistence and Graph Exfiltration
entry.summary: An adversary is using agentic AI to perform high-velocity reconnaissance, credential additions, and data exfiltration within our Microsoft 365 environment after compromising a trusted application.

entry.title: Storm-0940 AI-Accelerated Authentication
entry.summary: An adversary is using agentic AI to automate high-volume password spraying and service principal authentication from a known infrastructure range to bypass interactive sign-ins.

entry.title: Post-RCE Persistence and Credential Theft
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited a PHP core vulnerability (CVE-2026-109618/109619) and is using the web worker context to harvest credentials or establish persistence via reverse shells and web shells.

entry.title: PHP2Shell: Web-to-Shell Staging
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting PHP core RCE vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618/19) to force web server processes to spawn shells or interpreters, which then perform system discovery and payload staging.

entry.title: Platform-as-a-Proxy Phishing and Input Abuse
entry.summary: An adversary is using trusted third-party retail or SaaS infrastructure to deliver social-engineering lures by injecting fraudulent helpline numbers into transactional notification fields or abusing public-facing registration forms.

entry.title: PHP Remote Code Execution and Shell Activity
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting the php2shell vulnerabilities (CVE-2026-109618 or CVE-2026-109619) to execute unauthenticated code, which manifests as PHP worker processes spawning interactive shells or utility tools to retrieve secondary payloads.

entry.title: Amazon ClickFix Multi-stage Malware Infection
entry.summary: An adversary is deploying portable Node.js and IronPython interpreters to user-writable directories to execute obfuscated Doina loaders and Lumma infostealers.

entry.title: Amazon ClickFix Finger Utility Abuse
entry.summary: An adversary has lured a user to a spoofed Amazon page and pastejacked a command that uses finger.exe to download malicious payloads from a remote domain.

entry.title: AI-Assisted Execution and C2 Tunneling
entry.summary: An intruder is deploying AI-generated scripts for reverse shells and automated secret-scraping toolkits, using a centralized C2 infrastructure to coordinate post-exploitation activity.

entry.title: AI-Assisted Web Exploitation and Database Exfiltration
entry.summary: An intruder uses AI-generated reconnaissance to map web applications and performs targeted credential brute-forcing to exfiltrate databases.

entry.title: eMudhra Compromised Certificate and Go Runtime Audit
entry.summary: An adversary impersonates a trusted service or signs a malicious binary using a compromised eMudhra intermediate certificate in an environment that lacks strict revocation checking or runs a vulnerable Go runtime.

entry.title: SafePay Ransomware: Exfiltration and Impact
entry.summary: Adversaries have staged data using rare archival or cloud-sync tools and are now inhibiting system recovery by deleting shadow copies before executing a ransomware payload that renames user files to include the .SafePay extension.

entry.title: SafePay: Internal Discovery and Lateral Movement
entry.summary: An adversary is using legitimate administrative tools and scripts to enumerate network shares and move laterally via remote management protocols while disabling local security software.

entry.title: SafePay: External Access and Identity Consolidation
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited a known edge vulnerability to gain a foothold and is consolidating control by creating administrative accounts and escalating local privileges via UAC bypass.

entry.title: Ad-Driven Phishing and Malware Delivery
entry.summary: An adversary is using fraudulent social media advertisements to lure users into phishing sites or trick them into installing remote access tools, identified by browser-originating traffic from social platforms followed by rare process execution.

entry.title: SafePay: Internal Enumeration and Lateral Movement
entry.summary: SafePay actors have established a foothold and are using repurposed administrative tools, credential dumpers, and anomalous RDP or SMB sessions to move laterally toward file shares.

entry.title: SafePay Ransomware: Perimeter Breach and Account Persistence
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited unpatched edge vulnerabilities or use VPN-based brute force to gain initial access, subsequently creating or elevating accounts to secure administrative persistence.

entry.title: Abuse of Flowise AI Orchestration Platforms
entry.summary: An attacker is exploiting unauthenticated Flowise instances to harvest stored API credentials and hijack AI agents for internal network reconnaissance and financial data exfiltration.

entry.title: Virtualization Pivot and Host Encryption
entry.summary: The adversary has exploited a VPN gateway to breach the perimeter and is now pivoting to the virtualization layer to disable security controls and deploy ransomware via virtual disk manipulation.

entry.title: VPN Gateway Exploitation and Unauthorized Authentication
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited CVE-2026-0257 on a PAN-OS gateway to bypass authentication and establish a VPN session, identifiable by suspicious client hostnames, MAC addresses, or PoC-specific user agents.

entry.title: Zimbra Post-Exploitation and Cluster Exfiltration
entry.summary: An attacker who has compromised a Zimbra server is harvesting service credentials and moving laterally to peer nodes using the Zimbra SSH identity to exfiltrate mailbox data via specialized Go implants.

entry.title: Email Bombing and Identity Takeover Correlation
entry.summary: An attacker is using an email sign-up flood as a smokescreen to hide security alerts while they perform account takeovers and install remote access tools via tech support scams.

entry.title: ConnectWise M365 Application Abuse
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited compromised ConnectWise (SkyKick) vendor credentials to access M365 tenants, escalate directory privileges, and persist by adding secrets to secondary applications.

entry.title: Delivery and Payload Execution Monitoring
entry.summary: An adversary has established initial access through a compromised supply chain or a phishing attachment, resulting in unusual package installations or rare process execution from browser-originating downloads.

entry.title: BeyondTrust Appliance Identity Persistence and Evasion
entry.summary: An attacker who has exploited CVE-2026-102764 is establishing persistence by creating administrative accounts or modifying MFA factors while disabling logging services to hide their presence.

entry.title: BeyondTrust Appliance Compromise and Execution
entry.summary: An adversary has exploited CVE-2026-102764 to bypass authentication on a BeyondTrust Remote Support appliance, resulting in unauthorized file operations and the execution of unrecognized scripts.

entry.title: Interactive Shells and Data Collection (CL-UNK-1211)
entry.summary: An adversary is using in-memory reverse shells to conduct interactive discovery and exfiltrate government mailboxes, likely use AI-assisted scripting patterns for efficiency.

entry.title: Linux Persistence and Credential Hijacking
entry.summary: An adversary has established persistence on Linux web servers using AI-generated PHP web shells and hijacked administrative credentials by tampering with shell profiles and configuration files.

entry.title: Thermo Fisher Torrent Suite Path Traversal Exposure
entry.summary: An authenticated intruder is exploiting a path traversal vulnerability (CVE-2026-107777) in Thermo Fisher Torrent Suite Software to exfiltrate sensitive configuration and system files from healthcare servers.

entry.title: Autonomous AI Agent and Shadow AI Activity
entry.summary: An adversary is using AI-assisted exploitation or fraudulent identity onboarding to gain initial access, followed by the deployment of automated synthetic insiders that move data to unauthorized LLM providers at machine speed.

entry.title: Medicare Open Enrollment Social Engineering
entry.summary: An adversary is using lookalike domains during the Medicare Open Enrollment season to harvest personal and medical data via social engineering, subsequently using those credentials to access sensitive health and banking portals.

entry.title: Anonymizing Infrastructure and Tor Usage
entry.summary: An intruder or unauthorized user is using commercial VPNs or the Tor Browser to bypass network security controls, leaving evidence in software inventory, rare outbound port patterns, and proxy-flagged authentications.

entry.title: J4Care dcm4che Vulnerability Exposure
entry.summary: An adversary is exploiting unauthenticated REST services or malformed JPEG parsing in dcm4chee-arc-light to delete medical records or cause a denial-of-service condition on exposed healthcare assets.

entry.title: Regional Government and Infrastructure Espionage Activity
entry.summary: An espionage actor has established a beachhead via edge appliance exploitation or archive delivery, established persistence through scheduled tasks, and is maintaining access via a PowerShell-based reverse shell.

entry.title: Ransomware Recovery Inhibition and Encryption
entry.summary: An adversary is inhibiting system recovery by deleting volume shadow copies using standard tools or scripts before performing mass file encryption with rare extensions.

entry.title: M365 Session Hijacking and Mailbox Manipulation
entry.summary: An adversary has hijacked an authenticated Microsoft 365 session using stolen cookies, bypassing MFA to create stealthy inbox rules and perform fraudulent financial transactions.

entry.title: ClickFix Shell Execution and Cookie Theft
entry.summary: An intruder has used a social engineering lure to trick a macOS user into executing a malicious shell command in Terminal that steals browser session cookies for account takeover.

entry.title: Identity Compromise and SaaS Persistence
entry.summary: An adversary has bypassed MFA via session hijacking or proxy usage and is establishing persistence through malicious inbox rules or unauthorized OAuth applications in a SaaS environment.

entry.title: AI Social Engineering and Ransomware Operations
entry.summary: An adversary uses an AI-crafted social engineering lure to execute a loader that performs data staging or ransomware encryption.

entry.title: Identity-Centric Business Email Compromise
entry.summary: An adversary has hijacked an identity through an Adversary-in-the-Middle proxy or by exploiting a public-facing vulnerability, then manipulates mailbox rules to hide fraudulent communication and spreads malicious internal attachments.

entry.title: Passkey-Themed Phishing and Identity Lifecycle Abuse
entry.summary: An attacker uses social engineering lures themed around passkey enrollment to trick users into authorizing a device-code login flow, subsequently registering unauthorized authenticators and establishing persistence via cloud application grants or unapproved browser extensions.

entry.title: Unauthorized VPN Access via Stolen WatchGuard Credentials
entry.summary: Adversaries are using credentials stolen from lookalike WatchGuard VPN download sites to authenticate to corporate VPNs from anomalous geographic regions or hosting provider IP space.

entry.title: WatchGuard VPN Lookalike Phishing and Payload Delivery
entry.summary: An adversary is using SEO poisoning to lead users to fake WatchGuard VPN download sites that harvest credentials via a JavaScript modal before delivering the legitimate, signed installer.

entry.title: Fortinet Management Plane Exploitation and PEERSTITCH Deployment
entry.summary: An attacker has exploited a central management appliance to exfiltrate configurations and then used stolen credentials to deploy a memory-resident ARM64 implant on managed firewalls.

entry.title: Masqueraded MSP360 RMM Installer and Persistence
entry.summary: An attacker is distributing a legitimate but masqueraded MSP360 RMM installer via phishing lures to establish persistent, service-based administrative access on endpoints.

entry.title: Industrial Protocol Abuse on Legacy Manufacturing Assets
entry.summary: Adversaries target legacy Windows 7 and XP systems used as HMIs to bridge into OT networks by using unencrypted management protocols like Telnet and FTP for lateral movement.

entry.title: Abuse of Remote Gateways and Third-Party Access
entry.summary: An adversary has breached a manufacturing network by using stolen vendor credentials on a VPN gateway or by exploiting a phishing foothold to traverse an IT-to-OT jump server.

entry.title: Phishing Infrastructure and Interactive Exfiltration
entry.summary: An adversary is operating the Iron Man System phishing kit to harvest credentials in real-time, using specific domains for infrastructure management and Telegram for automated exfiltration.

entry.title: Cloud Tenant Hijacking and Service Principal Abuse
entry.summary: An adversary uses stolen application secrets for application-only authentication to hijack M365 tenants, subsequently escalating privileges via the Graph API to host phishing infrastructure on SharePoint and OneDrive.
